text:
maria: Heads up — just noticed a big spike in central audit S3 writes starting ~02:10 UTC. Cost alert triggered and a few new GPU nodes in ap-south failed to finish onboarding (keystore decrypt errors). Looks like a policy change rolled by infra yesterday. :frowning:

 taylor: ugh, which policy? any logs on KMS errors?

 maria: KMS returns AccessDenied with context showing Condition 'aws:SourceVpc' on the keystore role. stack traces from nodes show: 
```
KMSClientError: AccessDeniedException: Missing required condition aws:SourceVpc
 at keystore.decrypt
```

 alex: that explains it. we tightened the keystore policy to restrict decrypt to VPC endpoints (privatelink) during the compliance sweep. cross-region transient onboarding uses STS from control plane -> privatelink in other region, looks like that path isn't matching the new condition for ap-south.

 luca: and the audit logs? why S3 spike?

 maria: central audit pipeline got reconfigured to stream every debug-level event into the long-retention bucket (retention 365d) instead of the 30d staging bucket. so high-frequency keystore auth failures plus normal control-plane telemetry blew up put requests.

 taylor: incident created: IR-2026-042 (ops-bot). tagging @oncall. we should triage two axes: (1) restore node onboarding (keystore decrypt) (2) stop audit churn to central bucket to cap cost.

 ops-bot: IR-2026-042 created. Priority: P1 (potential capacity impact). Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/keystore-onboard

 alex: immediate mitigation: 1) temporarily allow decrypt from control-plane SG by adding aws:SourceVpc or SourceIp condition for the control-plane privatelink endpoint 2) add a short-term S3 lifecycle rule to move debug-level objects to GLACIER or expire in 7d 3) throttle audit shipping for debug logs.

 luca: can we avoid policy rollback? compliance wants the VPC condition. perhaps add an explicit allow for the control-plane privatelink principal + a limited time window. I'll draft a policy change and post it for review.

 maria: agreed. for onboarding unblocking i pushed a minimal policy tweak to the keystore role (allow decrypt from control-plane endpoint id) — testing now.

 taylor: results?

 maria: nodes in ap-south retried and 4/6 completed onboarding. two still failing (sts tokens expired). requeued them.

 alex: for audit cost: I applied a lifecycle to the central bucket with a rule to expire objects in the debug/ prefix after 7d and moved current debug/ prefix to lifecycle-rule-apply tag. CLI I ran: 
```
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-audit-central --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"expire-debug-7d","Prefix":"debug/","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":7}}]}'
```

 luca: good. also reduced the streaming QPS from 2000->200 for debug level in the pipeline config.

 taylor: next (post-mitigations): create a canary for privatelink condition (unit test that simulates node decrypt from each region). we should also document the required service endpoints that need explicit allow in the policy.

 maria: opening follow-ups: INFRA-1789 (policy whitelists + canary) assigned to luca, EST 2d. COST-2334 (audit-retention cleanup + budget alert) assigned to alex, EST 1d. OPS-7891 (requeue failed nodes + retry logic) assigned to taylor, EST 1d.

 deploy-bot: Deploy rollback (keystore-policy) flagged as manual. No automated rollback available for yesterday's infra sweep.

 taylor: decision summary: don't fully rollback the VPC condition. apply targeted allow for control-plane privatelink and add audit lifecycle + throttle. add canary and docs. we will re-audit the policy after canary passes.

 maria: thanks everyone. tagging postmortem owners: luca + alex. I'll follow up with the cost snapshot and node list. :thumbsup:

 alex: quick note — billing alarm threshold updated to +20% for central-audit-bucket to alert earlier.

 luca: filing a tiny automation PR to add the control-plane endpoint id to the keystore policy when new regions are onboarded. will link CR once ready.

 taylor: closing the P1 after verification. will update IR-2026-042 with remediation notes and link to postmortem.

 maria: final: if anyone sees more failing onboards, DM me.
